question: What alternative height is allowed relative to the Viṣṇu portion of the liṅga?
premises: The Viṣṇu part sets a height reference
An additional half-foot may be included
inference: Alternatively, the height may equal the Viṣṇu part together with an added half-foot.
plain_english: Or else it may be equal in height to the Viṣṇu portion together with half a foot.
